name: Ricarda Table Lamp
desc: A minimalist globe table lamp featuring a spherical opal glass shade, a slender tapered stem, and a round white marble-style base. Its compact sculptural form provides soft diffused illumination and suits contemporary dining tables, bedside tables, consoles, and modern living spaces.

specifications.Light Source: Integrated LED or compact LED bulb
specifications.Estimated Dimensions: Approx. 360 mm overall height x 160 mm globe diameter
specifications.Recommended Use: Dining table / Bedside table / Console / Living room / Lounge
